atoms.a: John wants to install a new fence around his garden for his dog to run around freely. What does John need to measure so that his fence has the right length?
atoms.b: John needs to measure the ((++perimeter area)) of his garden.

instruction.text: Calculate the perimeter of John’s garden.
Anne likes to draw rectangles. Fill in the gaps to calculate the perimeters of her drawings.

atoms.a: First, Anne draws a rectangle. What is its perimeter?
Next, Anne decides to combine some of her drawings to create a new shape. What is the perimeter of the new shape on the right?
Anne had so much fun combining shapes that she decided to create another one. What is the perimeter of the new shape on the right?

instruction.text: Lucy just bought a new car with a length of 3 m, but she forgot to measure the length of her garage beforehand. Luckily, Lucy knows that the width of the garage is 2 m and the perimeter of the garage is 12 m. Fill in the gaps to calculate the length of the missing side of Lucy’s garage.
